heading: Tonight
text: Mostly clear, with a few clouds moving in overnight. Patchy valley fog developing before dawn. Lows from the upper 40s to low 50s. Light and variable wind.

heading: Sunday
text: Morning fog burning off to partly sunny skies, then clouds moving in from the west. Highs from the upper 70s tonear 80. Light south wind.

heading: Sunday Night
text: Rain showers developing in the west, then spreading east overnight. Lows in the 50s to near 60. Light and variable wind.
